inputs.text: This is exactly how a public-safety concern can be weaponized: blame immigrants and local officials without establishing that sanctuary policies caused the danger, then present harsher federal enforcement as the only solution. A credible response should focus on evidence, accountability, and keeping people safe—not treating immigration status as proof of threat. We can protect communities while upholding due process and refusing to scapegoat vulnerable people.
